```{r}
#Looking into different metrics for scm detection
f_max <- f %>% 
  group_by(date, station) %>% 
  slice_max(f_npq, with_ties = F) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id, date, station, pres_max = pres, f_max = f_npq)

f2 <- f %>% 
  select(id, date, station, pres, f_npq) %>% 
  left_join(f_max) 

  
fwhm <- f2 %>% 
  select(id, date, station, pres, f_npq, f_max, pres_max) %>% 
  mutate(half_max = f_max/2) %>% 
  mutate(position = case_when(pres < pres_max ~ "above",
                              pres > pres_max ~ "below")) %>% 
  group_by(date, station, position) %>% 
  slice(which.min(abs(f_npq - half_max))) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(id, fwhm_pres = pres, position, pres_max) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(position)) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(n = n()) %>% 
  ungroup()

f3 <- f2 %>% 
  left_join(fwhm) 

check <- f3 %>% 
  filter(is.na(n))

f4 <- f3 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = "position", values_from = "fwhm_pres") %>%
  mutate(scm_width = below - above)


int50 <- f4 %>% 
  filter(pres < 51) %>% 
  group_by(id, date, station) %>% 
  summarise(int_50 = sum(f_npq)) %>% 
  ungroup()

f5 <- f4 %>% 
  left_join(int50)

scm_metrics <- f5 %>% 
  select(id, date, station,
         f_max,
          pres_max,
         fwhm_shallow = above,
         fwhm_deep = below,
         scm_width,
         scm_width,
         int_50) %>% 
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(max_int = (f_max/int_50)*100) %>% 
  mutate(scm = case_when(pres_max == 1 ~ F,
                         fwhm_shallow == 1 ~ F,
                         fwhm_deep < 5 ~ F,
                         is.na(fwhm_shallow) ~ F))
```

```{r}
width %>% 
  mutate(month = month(date)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(month), y = int_50)) +
  geom_boxplot()
```
